use_drop_path_function: apply stochastic depth dropout to a tensor with configurable drop probability during training
create_DropPath_module: create a DropPath nn.Module that applies stochastic depth dropout per sample in residual blocks
create_GraphDropPath_module: create a GraphDropPath nn.Module that drops paths considering batch indices for graph data
create_EquivariantDropout_module: create an EquivariantDropout nn.Module that applies equivariant dropout using e3nn irreps and elementwise tensor product
create_EquivariantScalarsDropout_module: create an EquivariantScalarsDropout nn.Module that applies dropout only to scalar irreps in equivariant tensors
